name: ServiceTitan
tagline: ServiceTitan is a field service management platform built for electricians, plumbers, and HVAC contractors, covering scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and inventory. Its AI features score incoming calls for booking likelihood, recommend pricing based on past jobs, and route technicians to minimize drive time. It is one of the most widely used platforms in the trades.
